name: Recursive Octree Network (RocNet)
definition: A deep recursive octree network for the compression of 3D voxel data. It compresses a voxel grid of any size down to a very small latent space in an autoencoder-like network.
summary: RocNet is a deep recursive autoencoder that compresses 3D voxel data into a compact latent space by restricting convolution to within octants, unlike other methods that cross boundaries.
